nodes.description: mapping(address => uint256) balances defined in BasicToken, tracks token balances of each account
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) allowed in StandardToken, ERC20 allowance table
address public owner in Ownable, privileged account of the contract
uint256 public totalSupply in ERC20Basic, total token supply
BasicToken.transfer(address _to, uint256 _value) moves tokens from msg.sender to _to and updates balances
StandardToken.transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value) moves tokens using allowance of msg.sender
StandardToken.approve(address _spender, uint256 _value) sets allowance of msg.sender for _spender
StandardToken.increaseApproval(address _spender, uint _addedValue) increases the allowance
StandardToken.decreaseApproval(address _spender, uint _subtractedValue) decreases the allowance with a floor at zero
BasicToken.balanceOf(address _owner) constant returns balances[_owner]
StandardToken.allowance(address _owner, address _spender) constant returns allowed[_owner][_spender]
SafeMath.add(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure, asserts c >= a after addition
SafeMath.sub(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure, asserts b <= a before subtraction
SafeMath.mul(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure, asserts a == 0 || c / a == b after multiplication
SafeMath.div(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure, division relying on EVM revert for b == 0
Ownable() constructor setting owner = msg.sender
Ownable.transferOwnership(address newOwner) public onlyOwner, writes owner = newOwner
BNIToken() constructor setting owner, totalSupply = initialSupply and minting initialSupply to owner
msg.sender, external caller used as balance owner, allowance owner and authorization subject
balances[msg.sender].sub(_value) inside transfer, arithmetic subtraction guarded only by SafeMath assert
balances[_to].add(_value) inside transfer, arithmetic addition writing recipient balance
balances[_from].sub(_value) inside transferFrom, arithmetic subtraction on the source balance
allowed[_from][msg.sender].sub(_value) inside transferFrom, arithmetic subtraction on the allowance
allowed[msg.sender][_spender].add(_addedValue) inside increaseApproval, arithmetic addition on allowance
oldValue.sub(_subtractedValue) inside decreaseApproval, arithmetic subtraction on allowance
owner = newOwner privileged state write inside transferOwnership, ownership transfer guarded only by onlyOwner
